paper.title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification

reported_claims.claim_source: paper authors' abstract; not independently reproduced by Symtropy

code_source.runtime_dependency_note: The README states that JaxRLWorld is external to PyPI and must be installed from the SimForge repository.

observed_method.fim_estimator: finite-difference state sensitivity from main and auxiliary perturbed simulation environments
observed_method.state_channel_policy: state channels can be restricted to hardware-measurable channels; README/code comments explicitly warn against optimizing information in unobservable state directions

trajectory_segmentation.aggregation: each parameter receives its best segment score
trajectory_segmentation.parameter_aggregation: negative sum of logarithms of per-parameter scores

observed_method.alpha_interpretation: alpha=1 is a scale-free decoupling ratio; alpha<1 also rewards stronger absolute excitation on weakly observed axes
observed_method.optimizer: CMA-ES command-trajectory optimization; Bezier trajectories are executed through a trained policy

symtropy_comparator_scope.implemented: two-parameter Schur-decoupling coverage score and synthetic negative controls
symtropy_comparator_scope.claim_boundary: The Symtropy score is a reduced analytic comparator only; it is not a reproduction or validation of IDTD.
